annotations.title: Leave a plan on a position

description: Have TradeHub act on a held position later, with no agent connected: "close it if still open in 3 days", "tell me if its funding passes 50% a year", "close half below 94000". Up to 5 rules, each fired once: when price_above / price_below (mark), held_hours (since set) or funding_above (yearly rate it pays, 0.5 = 50%), then notify the person or close close_pct reduce-only. thesis: why it is open, what proves it wrong, for later sessions. Use right after entry, not your own timers. Not a stop-loss. A new plan replaces the old; rules=[] removes it. Next: get_my_open_positions.
